newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq inches higher at close.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq inches higher at close.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks inched into positive territory at the close but failed to match the Dow's rally after a morning sell-off following the U.S. missile strike against Iraq.
Analysts said the Dow Industrials got a lift from their large energy representation while Nasdaq suffered from continued skittishness concerning technology issues.
"The techs' relative performance has been on the skids. Many portfolio managers have backed off from the sector," said Hugh Johnson, chief investment officer at First Albany Corp.

The Nasdaq Composite Index was up 0.85, or 0.07 percent, to 1142.35 at its unofficial close after going as low 1123.14. Declines led advancing issues by 2424 to 1556 on volume of about 400 million shares.

Stock of Boatmen's Bancshares Inc was down 3/4 at 52-1/2. Morgan Stanely said it cut its rating on the stock to neutral from outperform in response to its 24 percent rally on Friday after announcing it had agreed to merge with NationsBank Corp. Ascend Communications Inc unveiled a new wide area network switching system, called MAX TNT, offering a united platform for dial-up and dedicated traffic. Shares were up 2-1/2 at 54-7/8 in active trading.
